description: Run a process once, right now, instead of waiting for its schedule. The run spends the organization's wallet. Use this when someone wants the result immediately, or wants to see what a process produces before committing it to a schedule -- running it once first is usually the better order. Call list_processes for the exact agent externalId and SOP title.
